ayahs.textArabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّ ٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ وَٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yaa-aiyuhan Nabiyyut taqil laaha Wa-laa tuti'il kaafireena wal-munaafiqeen; innal laaha kaana 'aleeman Hakeemaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: O Prophet, fear Allah and do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: O Prophet! ˹Always˺ be mindful of Allah, and do not yield to the disbelievers and the hypocrites. Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱتَّبِعۡ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيۡكَ مِن رَّبِّكَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wattabi' maa yoohaaa ilaika mir Rabbik; innal laaha kaana bimaa ta'maloona Khabeera
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And follow that which is revealed to you from your Lord. Indeed Allah is ever, with what you do, Acquainted.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Follow what is revealed to you from your Lord. Surely Allah is All-Aware of what you ˹all˺ do.

ayahs.textArabic: وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ وَكِيلٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa-tawakkal 'alal laah; Wa-kafaa billaahi Wakeelaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And rely upon Allah; and sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And put your trust in Allah, for Allah is sufficient as a Trustee of Affairs.

ayahs.textArabic: مَّا جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِرَجُلٖ مِّن قَلۡبَيۡنِ فِي جَوۡفِهِۦۚ وَمَا جَعَلَ أَزۡوَٰجَكُمُ ٱلَّٰٓـِٔي تُظَٰهِرُونَ مِنۡهُنَّ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمۡۚ وَمَا جَعَلَ أَدۡعِيَآءَكُمۡ أَبۡنَآءَكُمۡۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ قَوۡلُكُم بِأَفۡوَٰهِكُمۡۖ وَٱللَّهُ يَقُولُ ٱلۡحَقَّ وَهُوَ يَهۡدِي ٱلسَّبِيلَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Maa ja'alal laahu lirajulim min qalbaini fee jawfih; Wa-maa ja'ala azwaajakumul laaa'ee tuzaahiroona minhunna ummahaatikum; Wa-maa ja'ala ad'iyaaa'akum abnaaa'akum; zaalikum qawlukum bi-afwaa-hikum wallaahu yaqoolul haqqa Wa-Huwa yahdis sabeel
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Allah has not made for a man two hearts in his interior. And He has not made your wives whom you declare unlawful your mothers. And he has not made your adopted sons your [true] sons. That is [merely] your saying by your mouths, but Allah says the truth, and He guides to the [right] way.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Allah does not place two hearts in any person’s chest. Nor does He regard your wives as ˹unlawful for you like˺ your real mothers, ˹even˺ if you say they are. Nor does He regard your adopted children as your real children. These are only your baseless assertions. But Allah declares the truth, and He ˹alone˺ guides to the ˹Right˺ Way.

ayahs.textArabic: ٱدۡعُوهُمۡ لِأٓبَآئِهِمۡ هُوَ أَقۡسَطُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِۚ فَإِن لَّمۡ تَعۡلَمُوٓاْ ءَابَآءَهُمۡ فَإِخۡوَٰنُكُمۡ فِي ٱلدِّينِ وَمَوَٰلِيكُمۡۚ وَلَيۡسَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ جُنَاحٞ فِيمَآ أَخۡطَأۡتُم بِهِۦ وَلَٰكِن مَّا تَعَمَّدَتۡ قُلُوبُكُمۡۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورٗا رَّحِيمًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ud'oohum li-aabaaa'ihim huwa aqsatu 'indal laah; fa-il lam ta'lamooo aabaaa'ahum fa-ikhwaanukum fid deeni Wa-mawaaleekum; Wa-laisa 'alaikum junaahun feemaaa akhtaatum bihee Wa-laakim maa ta'ammadat quloobukum; Wa-kaanal laahu Ghafoorar Raheemaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Call them by [the names of] their fathers; it is more just in the sight of Allah. But if you do not know their fathers - then they are [still] your brothers in religion and those entrusted to you. And there is no blame upon you for that in which you have erred but [only for] what your hearts intended. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Let your adopted children keep their family names. That is more just in the sight of Allah. But if you do not know their fathers, then they are ˹simply˺ your fellow believers and close associates. There is no blame on you for what you do by mistake, but ˹only˺ for what you do intentionally. And Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلنَّبِيُّ أَوۡلَىٰ بِٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ مِنۡ أَنفُسِهِمۡۖ وَأَزۡوَٰجُهُۥٓ أُمَّهَٰتُهُمۡۗ وَأُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَرۡحَامِ بَعۡضُهُمۡ أَوۡلَىٰ بِبَعۡضٖ فِي كِتَٰبِ ٱللَّهِ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُهَٰجِرِينَ إِلَّآ أَن تَفۡعَلُوٓاْ إِلَىٰٓ أَوۡلِيَآئِكُم مَّعۡرُوفٗاۚ كَانَ ذَٰلِكَ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مَسۡطُورٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: An-Nabiyyu awlaa bil-mu'mineena min anfusihim Wa-azwaajuhoo ummahatuhum Wa-ulul arhaami ba'duhum awlaa biba'din fee Kitaabil laahi minal mu'meneena wal-Muhaajireena illaaa an taf'alooo ilaaa awliyaaa'ikum ma'roofaa; kaana zaalika fil kitaabi mastooraa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The Prophet is more worthy of the believers than themselves, and his wives are [in the position of] their mothers. And those of [blood] relationship are more entitled [to inheritance] in the decree of Allah than the [other] believers and the emigrants, except that you may do to your close associates a kindness [through bequest]. That was in the Book inscribed.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The Prophet has a stronger affinity to the believers than they do themselves. And his wives are their mothers. As ordained by Allah, blood relatives are more entitled ˹to inheritance˺ than ˹other˺ believers and immigrants, unless you ˹want to˺ show kindness to your ˹close˺ associates ˹through bequest˺. This is decreed in the Record.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذۡ أَخَذۡنَا مِنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ مِيثَٰقَهُمۡ وَمِنكَ وَمِن نُّوحٖ وَإِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَى ٱبۡنِ مَرۡيَمَۖ وَأَخَذۡنَا مِنۡهُم مِّيثَٰقًا غَلِيظٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa-iz akhaznaa minan Nabiyyeena meesaaqahum Wa-minka Wa-min Noohinw Wa-Ibraaheema Wa-Moosaa Wa-Eesab ni Maryama Wa-akhaznaa minhum meesaaqan ghaleezaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [mention, O Muhammad], when We took from the prophets their covenant and from you and from Noah and Abraham and Moses and Jesus, the son of Mary; and We took from them a solemn covenant.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And ˹remember˺ when We took a covenant from the prophets, as well as from you ˹O Prophet˺, and from Noah, Abraham, Moses, and Jesus, son of Mary. We did take a solemn covenant from ˹all of˺ them

ayahs.textArabic: لِّيَسۡـَٔلَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ عَن صِدۡقِهِمۡۚ وَأَعَدَّ لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Liyas'alas saadiqeena 'an sidqihim; Wa-a'adda lilkaa-fireena 'azaaban aleemaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: That He may question the truthful about their truth. And He has prepared for the disbelievers a painful punishment.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: so that He may question these men of truth about their ˹delivery of the˺ truth. And He has prepared a painful punishment for the disbelievers.

ayahs.textArabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱذۡكُرُواْ نِعۡمَةَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡكُمۡ إِذۡ جَآءَتۡكُمۡ جُنُودٞ فَأَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ رِيحٗا وَجُنُودٗا لَّمۡ تَرَوۡهَاۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yaaa-aiyyuhal lazeena aamanuz kuroo ni'matal laahi 'alaikum iz jaaa'atkum junoodun fa-arsalnaa 'alaihim reehanw Wa-junoodal lam tarawhaa; Wa-kaanal laahu bimaa ta'maloona Baseera
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: O you who have believed, remember the favor of Allah upon you when armies came to [attack] you and We sent upon them a wind and armies [of angels] you did not see. And ever is Allah, of what you do, Seeing.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: O believers! Remember Allah’s favour upon you when ˹enemy˺ forces came to ˹besiege˺ you ˹in Medina˺, so We sent against them a ˹bitter˺ wind and forces you could not see. And Allah is All-Seeing of what you do.

ayahs.textArabic: إِذۡ جَآءُوكُم مِّن فَوۡقِكُمۡ وَمِنۡ أَسۡفَلَ مِنكُمۡ وَإِذۡ زَاغَتِ ٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرُ وَبَلَغَتِ ٱلۡقُلُوبُ ٱلۡحَنَاجِرَ وَتَظُنُّونَ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلظُّنُونَا۠
ayahs.textTransliteration: Iz jaaa'ookum min fawqikum Wa-min asfala minkum Wa-iz zaaghatil absaaru Wa-balaghatil quloobul hanaajira Wa-tazunnoona billaahiz zunoonaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Remember] when they came at you from above you and from below you, and when eyes shifted [in fear], and hearts reached the throats and you assumed about Allah [various] assumptions.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Remember˺ when they came at you from east and west, when your eyes grew wild ˹in horror˺ and your hearts jumped into your throats, and you entertained ˹conflicting˺ thoughts about Allah.

ayahs.textArabic: هُنَالِكَ ٱبۡتُلِيَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ وَزُلۡزِلُواْ زِلۡزَالٗا شَدِيدٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hunaalikab tuliyal mu'minoona Wa-zulziloo zilzaalan shadeedaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: There the believers were tested and shaken with a severe shaking.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then and there the believers were put to the test, and were violently shaken.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذۡ يَقُولُ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٞ مَّا وَعَدَنَا ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥٓ إِلَّا غُرُورٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa-iz yaqoolul munaafiqoona wallazeena fee quloobihim maradum maa wa'adanal laahu Wa-Rasooluhooo illaa ghurooraa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [remember] when the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is disease said, "Allah and His Messenger did not promise us except delusion,"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And ˹remember˺ when the hypocrites and those with sickness in their hearts said, “Allah and His Messenger have promised us nothing but delusion!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذۡ قَالَت طَّآئِفَةٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ يَٰٓأَهۡلَ يَثۡرِبَ لَا مُقَامَ لَكُمۡ فَٱرۡجِعُواْۚ وَيَسۡتَـٔۡذِنُ فَرِيقٞ مِّنۡهُمُ ٱلنَّبِيَّ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّ بُيُوتَنَا عَوۡرَةٞ وَمَا هِيَ بِعَوۡرَةٍۖ إِن يُرِيدُونَ إِلَّا فِرَارٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa-iz qaalat taaa'ifatum minhum yaaa-ahla Yasriba laa muqaamaa lakum farji'oo; Wa-yastaazinu fareequm minhumun Nabiyya yaqooloona inna buyootanaa 'awrah; Wa-maa hiya bi'awratin iny yureedoona illaa firaaraa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when a faction of them said, "O people of Yathrib, there is no stability for you [here], so return [home]." And a party of them asked permission of the Prophet, saying, "Indeed, our houses are unprotected," while they were not exposed. They did not intend except to flee.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And ˹remember˺ when a group of them said, “O people of Yathrib! There is no point in you staying ˹here˺, so retreat!” Another group of them asked the Prophet’s permission ˹to leave˺, saying, “Our homes are vulnerable,” while ˹in fact˺ they were not vulnerable. They only wished to flee.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَوۡ دُخِلَتۡ عَلَيۡهِم مِّنۡ أَقۡطَارِهَا ثُمَّ سُئِلُواْ ٱلۡفِتۡنَةَ لَأٓتَوۡهَا وَمَا تَلَبَّثُواْ بِهَآ إِلَّا يَسِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: wa-law dukhilat 'alaihim min aqtaarihaa summa su'ilul fitnata la-aatawhaa Wa-maa talabbasoo bihaaa illaa yaseeraa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And if they had been entered upon from all its [surrounding] regions and fitnah had been demanded of them, they would have done it and not hesitated over it except briefly.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Had their city been sacked from all sides and they had been asked to abandon faith, they would have done so with little hesitation.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ كَانُواْ عَٰهَدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مِن قَبۡلُ لَا يُوَلُّونَ ٱلۡأَدۡبَٰرَۚ وَكَانَ عَهۡدُ ٱللَّهِ مَسۡـُٔولٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa-laqad kaanoo 'aahadul laaha min qablu laa yuwal-loonal adbaar; Wa-kaana 'ahdul laahi mas'oolaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they had already promised Allah before not to turn their backs and flee. And ever is the promise to Allah [that about which one will be] questioned.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They had already pledged to Allah earlier never to turn their backs ˹in retreat˺. And a pledge to Allah must be answered for.

ayahs.textArabic: قُل لَّن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلۡفِرَارُ إِن فَرَرۡتُم مِّنَ ٱلۡمَوۡتِ أَوِ ٱلۡقَتۡلِ وَإِذٗا لَّا تُمَتَّعُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul laien yanfa'akumul firaaru in farartum minal mawti awil qatli Wa-izal laa tumatta'oona illaa qaleelaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, [O Muhammad], "Never will fleeing benefit you if you should flee from death or killing; and then [if you did], you would not be given enjoyment [of life] except for a little."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Fleeing will not benefit you if you ˹try to˺ escape a natural or violent death. ˹If it is not your time,˺ you will only be allowed enjoyment for a little while.”

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِي يَعۡصِمُكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ إِنۡ أَرَادَ بِكُمۡ سُوٓءًا أَوۡ أَرَادَ بِكُمۡ رَحۡمَةٗۚ وَلَا يَجِدُونَ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيّٗا وَلَا نَصِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul man zal lazee ya'simukum minal laahi in araada bikum sooo'an aw araada bikum rahmah; Wa-laa yajidoona lahum min doonil laahi waliyyanw Wa-laa naseeraa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, "Who is it that can protect you from Allah if He intends for you an ill or intends for you a mercy?" And they will not find for themselves besides Allah any protector or any helper.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Ask ˹them, O Prophet˺, “Who can put you out of Allah’s reach if He intends to harm you or show you mercy?” They can never find any protector or helper besides Allah.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ قَدۡ يَعۡلَمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمُعَوِّقِينَ مِنكُمۡ وَٱلۡقَآئِلِينَ لِإِخۡوَٰنِهِمۡ هَلُمَّ إِلَيۡنَاۖ وَلَا يَأۡتُونَ ٱلۡبَأۡسَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qad ya'lamul laahul mu'awwiqeena minkum walqaaa'ileena li-ikhwaanihim halumma ilainaa, Wa-laa yaatoonal baasa illaa qaleelaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Already Allah knows the hinderers among you and those [hypocrites] who say to their brothers, "Come to us," and do not go to battle, except for a few,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Allah knows well those among you who discourage ˹others from fighting˺, saying ˹secretly˺ to their brothers, “Stay with us,” and who themselves hardly take part in fighting.

ayahs.textArabic: أَشِحَّةً عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ ٱلۡخَوۡفُ رَأَيۡتَهُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَيۡكَ تَدُورُ أَعۡيُنُهُمۡ كَٱلَّذِي يُغۡشَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ مِنَ ٱلۡمَوۡتِۖ فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ ٱلۡخَوۡفُ سَلَقُوكُم بِأَلۡسِنَةٍ حِدَادٍ أَشِحَّةً عَلَى ٱلۡخَيۡرِۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَمۡ يُؤۡمِنُواْ فَأَحۡبَطَ ٱللَّهُ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡۚ وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ashihhatan 'alaikum faizaa jaaa'al khawfu ra-aytahum yanzuroona ilaika tadooru a'yunuhum kallazee yughshaa 'alaihi minal mawti fa-izaa zahabal khawfu salqookum bi-alsinatin hidaadin ashibbatan 'alal khayr; ulaaa'ika lam yu'minoo fa-ahbatal laahu a'maalahum; Wa-kaana zaalika 'alal laahi yaseeraa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indisposed toward you. And when fear comes, you see them looking at you, their eyes revolving like one being overcome by death. But when fear departs, they lash you with sharp tongues, indisposed toward [any] good. Those have not believed, so Allah has rendered their deeds worthless, and ever is that, for Allah, easy.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹They are˺ totally unwilling to assist you. When danger comes, you see them staring at you with their eyes rolling like someone in the throes of death. But once the danger is over, they slash you with razor-sharp tongues, ravenous for ˹worldly˺ gains. Such people have not ˹truly˺ believed, so Allah has rendered their deeds void. And that is easy for Allah.

ayahs.textArabic: يَحۡسَبُونَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابَ لَمۡ يَذۡهَبُواْۖ وَإِن يَأۡتِ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ يَوَدُّواْ لَوۡ أَنَّهُم بَادُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَعۡرَابِ يَسۡـَٔلُونَ عَنۡ أَنۢبَآئِكُمۡۖ وَلَوۡ كَانُواْ فِيكُم مَّا قَٰتَلُوٓاْ إِلَّا قَلِيلٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yahsaboonal Ahzaaba lam yazhaboo Wa-ien yaatil Ahzaabu yawaddoo law annahum baadoona fil A'raabi yasaloona 'an ambaaa'ikum Wa-law kaanoo feekum maa qaatalooo illaa qaleela
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They think the companies have not [yet] withdrawn. And if the companies should come [again], they would wish they were in the desert among the bedouins, inquiring [from afar] about your news. And if they should be among you, they would not fight except for a little.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They ˹still˺ think that the enemy alliance has not ˹yet˺ withdrawn. And if the allies were to come ˹again˺, the hypocrites would wish to be away in the desert among nomadic Arabs, ˹only˺ asking for news about you ˹believers˺. And if the hypocrites were in your midst, they would hardly take part in the fight.

ayahs.textArabic: لَّقَدۡ كَانَ لَكُمۡ فِي رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ أُسۡوَةٌ حَسَنَةٞ لِّمَن كَانَ يَرۡجُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلۡيَوۡمَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَ وَذَكَرَ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Laqad kaana lakum fee Rasoolil laahi uswatun hasanatul liman kaana yarjul laaha wal-yawmal Aakhira Wa-azkaral laaha kaseeraa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: There has certainly been for you in the Messenger of Allah an excellent pattern for anyone whose hope is in Allah and the Last Day and [who] remembers Allah often.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, in the Messenger of Allah you have an excellent example for whoever has hope in Allah and the Last Day, and remembers Allah often.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَمَّا رَءَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابَ قَالُواْ هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَنَا ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥ وَصَدَقَ ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥۚ وَمَا زَادَهُمۡ إِلَّآ إِيمَٰنٗا وَتَسۡلِيمٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa-lammaa ra al-mu'minoonal Ahzaaba qaaloo haazaa maa wa'adanal laahu Wa-Rasooluh; Wa-sadaqal laahu Wa-Rasooluh; Wa-maa zaadahum illaaa eemaananw Wa-tasleemaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when the believers saw the companies, they said, "This is what Allah and His Messenger had promised us, and Allah and His Messenger spoke the truth." And it increased them only in faith and acceptance.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: When the believers saw the enemy alliance, they said, “This is what Allah and His Messenger had promised us. The promise of Allah and His Messenger has come true.” And this only increased them in faith and submission.

ayahs.textArabic: مِّنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ رِجَالٞ صَدَقُواْ مَا عَٰهَدُواْ ٱللَّهَ عَلَيۡهِۖ فَمِنۡهُم مَّن قَضَىٰ نَحۡبَهُۥ وَمِنۡهُم مَّن يَنتَظِرُۖ وَمَا بَدَّلُواْ تَبۡدِيلٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Minal mu'mineena rijaalun sadaqoo maa 'aahadul laaha 'alaihi faminhum man qadaa nahbahoo Wa-minhum mai yantaziru Wa-maa baddaloo tabdeelaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Among the believers are men true to what they promised Allah. Among them is he who has fulfilled his vow [to the death], and among them is he who awaits [his chance]. And they did not alter [the terms of their commitment] by any alteration -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Among the believers are men who have proven true to what they pledged to Allah. Some of them have fulfilled their pledge ˹with their lives˺, others are waiting ˹their turn˺. They have never changed ˹their commitment˺ in the least.

ayahs.textArabic: لِّيَجۡزِيَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ بِصِدۡقِهِمۡ وَيُعَذِّبَ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ إِن شَآءَ أَوۡ يَتُوبَ عَلَيۡهِمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ غَفُورٗا رَّحِيمٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Li-yajziyal aahus saadiqeena bisidqihim Wa-yu'azzibal munaafiqeena in shaaa'a aw yatooba 'alaihim; innal laaha kaana Ghafoorar Raheemaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: That Allah may reward the truthful for their truth and punish the hypocrites if He wills or accept their repentance. Indeed, Allah is ever Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹It all happened˺ so Allah may reward the faithful for their faithfulness, and punish the hypocrites if He wills or turn to them ˹in mercy˺. Surely Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

ayahs.textArabic: وَرَدَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِغَيۡظِهِمۡ لَمۡ يَنَالُواْ خَيۡرٗاۚ وَكَفَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ٱلۡقِتَالَۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ قَوِيًّا عَزِيزٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa-raddal laahul lazeena kafaroo bighaizihim lam yanaaloo khairaa; Wa-kafal laahul mu'mineenal qitaal; Wa-kaanal laahu Qawiyyan 'Azeezaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And Allah repelled those who disbelieved, in their rage, not having obtained any good. And sufficient was Allah for the believers in battle, and ever is Allah Powerful and Exalted in Might.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And Allah drove back the disbelievers in their rage, totally empty-handed. And Allah spared the believers from fighting. For Allah is All-Powerful, Almighty.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَنزَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَٰهَرُوهُم مِّنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِن صَيَاصِيهِمۡ وَقَذَفَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلرُّعۡبَ فَرِيقٗا تَقۡتُلُونَ وَتَأۡسِرُونَ فَرِيقٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa-anzalal lazeena zaaha-roohum min Ahlil Kitaabi min sa-yaaseehim Wa-qazafa fee quloobihimm mur-ru'ba fareeqan taqtuloona Wa-taasiroona fareeqaaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And He brought down those who supported them among the People of the Scripture from their fortresses and cast terror into their hearts [so that] a party you killed, and you took captive a party.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And He brought down those from the People of the Book who supported the enemy alliance from their own strongholds, and cast horror into their hearts. You ˹believers˺ killed some, and took others captive.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَوۡرَثَكُمۡ أَرۡضَهُمۡ وَدِيَٰرَهُمۡ وَأَمۡوَٰلَهُمۡ وَأَرۡضٗا لَّمۡ تَطَـُٔوهَاۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa-awrasakum ardahum Wa-diyaarahum Wa-amwaalahum Wa-ardal lam tata'oohaa; Wa-kaanal laahu 'alaa kulli shai'in Qadeeraa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And He caused you to inherit their land and their homes and their properties and a land which you have not trodden. And ever is Allah, over all things, competent.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He has also caused you to take over their lands, homes, and wealth, as well as lands you have not yet set foot on. And Allah is Most Capable of everything.

ayahs.textArabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّ قُل لِّأَزۡوَٰجِكَ إِن كُنتُنَّ تُرِدۡنَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَزِينَتَهَا فَتَعَالَيۡنَ أُمَتِّعۡكُنَّ وَأُسَرِّحۡكُنَّ سَرَاحٗا جَمِيلٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yaaa-aiyyuhan Nabiyyu qul li-azwaajika in kuntunna turidnal hayaatad dunyaa Wa-zeenatahaa fata'aalaina umatti'kunna Wa-usarrihkunna saraahan jameela
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: O Prophet, say to your wives, "If you should desire the worldly life and its adornment, then come, I will provide for you and give you a gracious release.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: O Prophet! Say to your wives, “If you desire the life of this world and its luxury, then come, I will give you a ˹suitable˺ compensation ˹for divorce˺ and let you go graciously.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِن كُنتُنَّ تُرِدۡنَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَٱلدَّارَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَعَدَّ لِلۡمُحۡسِنَٰتِ مِنكُنَّ أَجۡرًا عَظِيمٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa-in kuntunna turidnal laaha Wa-Rasoolahoo wad-Daaral Aakhirata fa-innal laaha a'adda lil-muhsinaati min-kunna ajjran 'azeemaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But if you should desire Allah and His Messenger and the home of the Hereafter - then indeed, Allah has prepared for the doers of good among you a great reward."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But if you desire Allah and His Messenger and the ˹everlasting˺ Home of the Hereafter, then Surely Allah has prepared a great reward for those of you who do good.”

ayahs.textArabic: يَٰنِسَآءَ ٱلنَّبِيِّ مَن يَأۡتِ مِنكُنَّ بِفَٰحِشَةٖ مُّبَيِّنَةٖ يُضَٰعَفۡ لَهَا ٱلۡعَذَابُ ضِعۡفَيۡنِۚ وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yaa-nisaaa'an Nabiyyi maien yaati minkunna bifaa-hishatim mubaiyyinatien yudaa'af lahal 'azaabu di'faini Wa-kaana zaalika 'alal laahi yaseera
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: O wives of the Prophet, whoever of you should commit a clear immorality - for her the punishment would be doubled two fold, and ever is that, for Allah, easy.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: O wives of the Prophet! If any of you were to commit a blatant misconduct, the punishment would be doubled for her. And that is easy for Allah.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَمَن يَقۡنُتۡ مِنكُنَّ لِلَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَتَعۡمَلۡ صَٰلِحٗا نُّؤۡتِهَآ أَجۡرَهَا مَرَّتَيۡنِ وَأَعۡتَدۡنَا لَهَا رِزۡقٗا كَرِيمٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa-maien yaqnut minkunna lillaahi Wa-Rasoolihee Wa-ta'mal saalihan nu'tihaaa ajrahaa marratayni Wa-a'tadnaa lahaa rizqan kareema
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And whoever of you devoutly obeys Allah and His Messenger and does righteousness - We will give her her reward twice; and We have prepared for her a noble provision.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And whoever of you devoutly obeys Allah and His Messenger and does good, We will grant her double the reward, and We have prepared for her an honourable provision.

ayahs.textArabic: يَٰنِسَآءَ ٱلنَّبِيِّ لَسۡتُنَّ كَأَحَدٖ مِّنَ ٱلنِّسَآءِ إِنِ ٱتَّقَيۡتُنَّۚ فَلَا تَخۡضَعۡنَ بِٱلۡقَوۡلِ فَيَطۡمَعَ ٱلَّذِي فِي قَلۡبِهِۦ مَرَضٞ وَقُلۡنَ قَوۡلٗا مَّعۡرُوفٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yaa-nisaaa'an Nabiyyi lastunna ka-ahadim minan nisaaa'i init taqaitunna falaa takhda'na bilqawli fa-yatma'al lazee fee qalbihee maradunw Wa-qulna qawlam ma'roofaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: O wives of the Prophet, you are not like anyone among women. If you fear Allah, then do not be soft in speech [to men], lest he in whose heart is disease should covet, but speak with appropriate speech.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: O wives of the Prophet! You are not like any other women: if you are mindful ˹of Allah˺, then do not be overly effeminate in speech ˹with men˺ or those with sickness in their hearts may be tempted, but speak in a moderate tone.

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَرۡنَ فِي بُيُوتِكُنَّ وَلَا تَبَرَّجۡنَ تَبَرُّجَ ٱلۡجَٰهِلِيَّةِ ٱلۡأُولَىٰۖ وَأَقِمۡنَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتِينَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَطِعۡنَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥٓۚ إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ لِيُذۡهِبَ عَنكُمُ ٱلرِّجۡسَ أَهۡلَ ٱلۡبَيۡتِ وَيُطَهِّرَكُمۡ تَطۡهِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa-qarna fee bu-yoo-tikunna Wa-laa tabarrajna tabarrujal Jaahiliyyatil oolaa Wa-aqimnas Salaata Wa-aaateenaz Zakaata Wa-ati'nal laaha Wa-Rasoolah; innamaa yureedul laahu liyuzhiba 'ankumur rijsa Ahlal Bayti Wa-yutahhirakum tatheeraa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And abide in your houses and do not display yourselves as [was] the display of the former times of ignorance. And establish prayer and give zakah and obey Allah and His Messenger. Allah intends only to remove from you the impurity [of sin], O people of the [Prophet's] household, and to purify you with [extensive] purification.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Settle in your homes, and do not display yourselves as women did in the days of ˹pre-Islamic˺ ignorance. Establish prayer, pay alms-tax, and obey Allah and His Messenger. Allah only intends to keep ˹the causes of˺ evil away from you and purify you completely, O members of the ˹Prophet’s˺ family!

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱذۡكُرۡنَ مَا يُتۡلَىٰ فِي بُيُوتِكُنَّ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡحِكۡمَةِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ لَطِيفًا خَبِيرًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wazkurna maa yutlaa fee bu-yootikunna min aayaatil laahi wal-Hikmah; innal laaha kaana lateefan Khabeera
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And remember what is recited in your houses of the verses of Allah and wisdom. Indeed, Allah is ever Subtle and Acquainted [with all things].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Always˺ remember what is recited in your homes of Allah’s revelations and ˹prophetic˺ wisdom. Surely Allah is Most Subtle, All-Aware.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ وَٱلۡمُسۡلِمَٰتِ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ وَٱلۡقَٰنِتِينَ وَٱلۡقَٰنِتَٰتِ وَٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ وَٱلصَّٰدِقَٰتِ وَٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ وَٱلصَّٰبِرَٰتِ وَٱلۡخَٰشِعِينَ وَٱلۡخَٰشِعَٰتِ وَٱلۡمُتَصَدِّقِينَ وَٱلۡمُتَصَدِّقَٰتِ وَٱلصَّٰٓئِمِينَ وَٱلصَّٰٓئِمَٰتِ وَٱلۡحَٰفِظِينَ فُرُوجَهُمۡ وَٱلۡحَٰفِظَٰتِ وَٱلذَّٰكِرِينَ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرٗا وَٱلذَّٰكِرَٰتِ أَعَدَّ ٱللَّهُ لَهُم مَّغۡفِرَةٗ وَأَجۡرًا عَظِيمٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innal muslimeena wal-muslimaati wal-mu'mineena wal-mu'minaati walqaaniteena walqaanitaati wassaadiqeena wassaadiqaati wassaabireena wassaabiraati walkhaashi'eena walkhaashi'aati walmutasaddiqeena walmutasaddiqaati wassaaa'imeena wassaaa'imaati walhaafizeena furoojahum walhaafizaati waz-zaakireenal laaha kaseeranw waz-zaakiraati a'addal laahu lahum maghfiratanw Wa-ajran 'azeemaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, the Muslim men and Muslim women, the believing men and believing women, the obedient men and obedient women, the truthful men and truthful women, the patient men and patient women, the humble men and humble women, the charitable men and charitable women, the fasting men and fasting women, the men who guard their private parts and the women who do so, and the men who remember Allah often and the women who do so - for them Allah has prepared forgiveness and a great reward.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely ˹for˺ Muslim men and women, believing men and women, devout men and women, truthful men and women, patient men and women, humble men and women, charitable men and women, fasting men and women, men and women who guard their chastity, and men and women who remember Allah often—for ˹all of˺ them Allah has prepared forgiveness and a great reward.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا كَانَ لِمُؤۡمِنٖ وَلَا مُؤۡمِنَةٍ إِذَا قَضَى ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥٓ أَمۡرًا أَن يَكُونَ لَهُمُ ٱلۡخِيَرَةُ مِنۡ أَمۡرِهِمۡۗ وَمَن يَعۡصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَقَدۡ ضَلَّ ضَلَٰلٗا مُّبِينٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa-maa kaana limu'mininw Wa-laa mu'minatin izaa qadal laahu Wa-Rasooluhooo amran aien yakoona lahumul khiyaratu min amrihim; Wa-maien ya'sil laaha Wa-Rasoolahoo faqad dalla dalaalam mubeenaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: It is not for a believing man or a believing woman, when Allah and His Messenger have decided a matter, that they should [thereafter] have any choice about their affair. And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger has certainly strayed into clear error.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It is not for a believing man or woman—when Allah and His Messenger decree a matter—to have any other choice in that matter. Indeed, whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger has clearly gone ˹far˺ astray.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذۡ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِيٓ أَنۡعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِ وَأَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيۡهِ أَمۡسِكۡ عَلَيۡكَ زَوۡجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخۡفِي فِي نَفۡسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبۡدِيهِ وَتَخۡشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخۡشَىٰهُۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيۡدٞ مِّنۡهَا وَطَرٗا زَوَّجۡنَٰكَهَا لِكَيۡ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ حَرَجٞ فِيٓ أَزۡوَٰجِ أَدۡعِيَآئِهِمۡ إِذَا قَضَوۡاْ مِنۡهُنَّ وَطَرٗاۚ وَكَانَ أَمۡرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفۡعُولٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa-iz taqoolu lillazeee an'amal laahu 'alaihi Wa-an'amta 'alaihi amsik 'alaika zawjaka wattaqil laaha Wa-tukhfee fee nafsika mal laahu mubdeehi Wa-takhshan naasa wallaahu ahaqqu an takhshaah; falammaa qadaa Zaidum minhaa wataran zawwajnaa-kahaa likay laa yakoona 'alal mu'mineena harajun feee azwaaji ad'iyaaa'ihim izaa qadaw minhunna wataraa; Wa-kaana amrul laahi maf'oolaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [remember, O Muhammad], when you said to the one on whom Allah bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allah," while you concealed within yourself that which Allah is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allah has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort concerning the wives of their adopted sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command of Allah accomplished.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And ˹remember, O Prophet,˺ when you said to the one for whom Allah has done a favour and you ˹too˺ have done a favour, “Keep your wife and fear Allah,” while concealing within yourself what Allah was going to reveal. And ˹so˺ you were considering the people, whereas Allah was more worthy of your consideration. So when Zaid totally lost interest in ˹keeping˺ his wife, We gave her to you in marriage, so that there would be no blame on the believers for marrying the ex-wives of their adopted sons after their divorce. And Allah’s command is totally binding.

ayahs.textArabic: مَّا كَانَ عَلَى ٱلنَّبِيِّ مِنۡ حَرَجٖ فِيمَا فَرَضَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُۥۖ سُنَّةَ ٱللَّهِ فِي ٱلَّذِينَ خَلَوۡاْ مِن قَبۡلُۚ وَكَانَ أَمۡرُ ٱللَّهِ قَدَرٗا مَّقۡدُورًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Maa kaana 'alan nabiyyyi min harajin feemaa faradal laahu lahoo sunnatal laahi fil lazeena khalaw min qabl; Wa-kaana amrul laahi qadaram maqdooraa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: There is not to be upon the Prophet any discomfort concerning that which Allah has imposed upon him. [This is] the established way of Allah with those [prophets] who have passed on before. And ever is the command of Allah a destiny decreed.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: There is no blame on the Prophet for doing what Allah has ordained for him. That has been the way of Allah with those ˹prophets˺ who had gone before. And Allah’s command has been firmly decreed.

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُبَلِّغُونَ رِسَٰلَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَخۡشَوۡنَهُۥ وَلَا يَخۡشَوۡنَ أَحَدًا إِلَّا ٱللَّهَۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ حَسِيبٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allazeena yuballighoona Risaalaatil laahi Wa-yakhshaw-nahoo Wa-laa yakkhshawna ahadan illal laah; Wa-kafaa billaahi Haseebaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Allah praises] those who convey the messages of Allah and fear Him and do not fear anyone but Allah. And sufficient is Allah as Accountant.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹That is His way with˺ those ˹prophets˺ who deliver the messages of Allah, and consider Him, and none but Allah. And sufficient is Allah as a ˹vigilant˺ Reckoner.

ayahs.textArabic: مَّا كَانَ مُحَمَّدٌ أَبَآ أَحَدٖ مِّن رِّجَالِكُمۡ وَلَٰكِن رَّسُولَ ٱللَّهِ وَخَاتَمَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Maa kaana Muhammmadun abaaa ahadim mir rijaalikum Wa-laakir Rasoolal laahi Wa-Khaataman Nabiyyeen; Wa-kaanal laahu bikulli shai'in 'Aleema
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Muhammad is not the father of [any] one of your men, but [he is] the Messenger of Allah and last of the prophets. And ever is Allah, of all things, Knowing.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Muḥammad is not the father of any of your men, but is the Messenger of Allah and the seal of the prophets. And Allah has ˹perfect˺ knowledge of all things.

ayahs.textArabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱذۡكُرُواْ ٱللَّهَ ذِكۡرٗا كَثِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yaaa-aiyyuhal lazeena aamanuz kurul laaha zikran kaseera
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: O you who have believed, remember Allah with much remembrance
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: O believers! Always remember Allah often,

ayahs.textArabic: وَسَبِّحُوهُ بُكۡرَةٗ وَأَصِيلًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa-sabbihoohu bukratanw Wa-aseela
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And exalt Him morning and afternoon.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and glorify Him morning and evening.

ayahs.textArabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُصَلِّي عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَمَلَٰٓئِكَتُهُۥ لِيُخۡرِجَكُم مِّنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِۚ وَكَانَ بِٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ رَحِيمٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Huwal lazee yusallee 'alaikum Wa-malaaa'ikatuhoo liyukhrijakum minaz zulumaati ilan noor Wa-kaana bilmu'mineena Raheemaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: It is He who confers blessing upon you, and His angels [ask Him to do so] that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light. And ever is He, to the believers, Merciful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He is the One Who showers His blessings upon you—and His angels pray for you—so that He may bring you out of darkness and into light. For He is ever Merciful to the believers.

ayahs.textArabic: تَحِيَّتُهُمۡ يَوۡمَ يَلۡقَوۡنَهُۥ سَلَٰمٞۚ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرٗا كَرِيمٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Tahiyyatuhum Yawma yalqawnahoo salaamunw Wa-a'adda lahum ajran kareemaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Their greeting the Day they meet Him will be, "Peace." And He has prepared for them a noble reward.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Their greeting on the Day they meet Him will be, “Peace!” And He has prepared for them an honourable reward.

ayahs.textArabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّ إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ شَٰهِدٗا وَمُبَشِّرٗا وَنَذِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yaaa-aiyyuhan Nabiyyu innaaa arsalnaaka shaahidanw Wa-mubashshiranw Wa-nazeeraa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: O Prophet, indeed We have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: O Prophet! We have sent you as a witness, and a deliverer of good news, and a warner,

ayahs.textArabic: وَدَاعِيًا إِلَى ٱللَّهِ بِإِذۡنِهِۦ وَسِرَاجٗا مُّنِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa-daa'iyan ilal laahi bi-iznihee Wa-siraajam muneeraa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And one who invites to Allah, by His permission, and an illuminating lamp.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and a caller to ˹the Way of˺ Allah by His command, and a beacon of light.

ayahs.textArabic: وَبَشِّرِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ بِأَنَّ لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ فَضۡلٗا كَبِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa-bashshiril mu'mineena bi-annna lahum minal laahi fadlan kabeera
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And give good tidings to the believers that they will have from Allah great bounty.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Give good news to the believers that they will have a great bounty from Allah.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ وَٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ وَدَعۡ أَذَىٰهُمۡ وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ وَكِيلٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa-laa tuti'il kaafireena walmunaafiqeena Wa-da 'azaahum Wa-tawakkal 'alal laah; Wa-kafaa billaahi Wakeelaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites but do not harm them, and rely upon Allah. And sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Do not yield to the disbelievers and the hypocrites. Overlook their annoyances, and put your trust in Allah. For Allah is sufficient as a Trustee of Affairs.

ayahs.textArabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِذَا نَكَحۡتُمُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ طَلَّقۡتُمُوهُنَّ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن تَمَسُّوهُنَّ فَمَا لَكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِنَّ مِنۡ عِدَّةٖ تَعۡتَدُّونَهَاۖ فَمَتِّعُوهُنَّ وَسَرِّحُوهُنَّ سَرَاحٗا جَمِيلٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yaaa-aiyyuhal lazeena aamanooo izaa nakahtumul mu'minaati summa tallaqtu-moohunna min qabli an tamas-soohunna famaa lakum 'alaihinna min 'iddatin ta'taddoonahaa famatti'oohunna Wa-sarri-hoohunna saraahan jameelaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: O You who have believed, when you marry believing women and then divorce them before you have touched them, then there is not for you any waiting period to count concerning them. So provide for them and give them a gracious release.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: O believers! If you marry believing women and then divorce them before you touch them, they will have no waiting period for you to count, so give them a ˹suitable˺ compensation, and let them go graciously.

ayahs.textArabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّ إِنَّآ أَحۡلَلۡنَا لَكَ أَزۡوَٰجَكَ ٱلَّٰتِيٓ ءَاتَيۡتَ أُجُورَهُنَّ وَمَا مَلَكَتۡ يَمِينُكَ مِمَّآ أَفَآءَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡكَ وَبَنَاتِ عَمِّكَ وَبَنَاتِ عَمَّٰتِكَ وَبَنَاتِ خَالِكَ وَبَنَاتِ خَٰلَٰتِكَ ٱلَّٰتِي هَاجَرۡنَ مَعَكَ وَٱمۡرَأَةٗ مُّؤۡمِنَةً إِن وَهَبَتۡ نَفۡسَهَا لِلنَّبِيِّ إِنۡ أَرَادَ ٱلنَّبِيُّ أَن يَسۡتَنكِحَهَا خَالِصَةٗ لَّكَ مِن دُونِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَۗ قَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا مَا فَرَضۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ فِيٓ أَزۡوَٰجِهِمۡ وَمَا مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُهُمۡ لِكَيۡلَا يَكُونَ عَلَيۡكَ حَرَجٞۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورٗا رَّحِيمٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yaaa-aiyyuhan Nabiyyu innaaa ahlalnaa laka azwaa-jakal laatee aataiyta ujoora-hunna Wa-maa malakat yameenuka mimmaaa afaaa'al laahu 'alaika Wa-banaati 'ammika Wa-banaati 'ammaatika Wa-banaati khaalika Wa-banaati khaalaa-tikal laatee haajarna ma'aka wamra'-atan mu'minatan inw wahabat nafsahaa lin-Nabiyyi in araadan Nabiyyu aien yastan-kihahaa khaalisatan laka min doonil mu'mineen; qad 'alimnaa maa faradnaa 'alaihim feee azwaajihim Wa-maa malakat aimaanuhum li-kailaa yakoona 'alaika haraj; Wa-kaanal laahu Ghafoorar Raheema
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: O Prophet, indeed We have made lawful to you your wives to whom you have given their due compensation and those your right hand possesses from what Allah has returned to you [of captives] and the daughters of your paternal uncles and the daughters of your paternal aunts and the daughters of your maternal uncles and the daughters of your maternal aunts who emigrated with you and a believing woman if she gives herself to the Prophet [and] if the Prophet wishes to marry her, [this is] only for you, excluding the [other] believers. We certainly know what We have made obligatory upon them concerning their wives and those their right hands possess, [but this is for you] in order that there will be upon you no discomfort. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: O Prophet! We have made lawful for you your wives to whom you have paid their ˹full˺ dowries as well as those ˹bondwomen˺ in your possession, whom Allah has granted you. And ˹you are allowed to marry˺ the daughters of your paternal uncles and aunts, and the daughters of your maternal uncles and aunts, who have emigrated like you. Also ˹allowed for marriage is˺ a believing woman who offers herself to the Prophet ˹without dowry˺ if he is interested in marrying her—˹this is˺ exclusively for you, not for the rest of the believers. We know well what ˹rulings˺ We have ordained for the believers in relation to their wives and those ˹bondwomen˺ in their possession. As such, there would be no blame on you. And Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ تُرۡجِي مَن تَشَآءُ مِنۡهُنَّ وَتُـٔۡوِيٓ إِلَيۡكَ مَن تَشَآءُۖ وَمَنِ ٱبۡتَغَيۡتَ مِمَّنۡ عَزَلۡتَ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيۡكَۚ ذَٰلِكَ أَدۡنَىٰٓ أَن تَقَرَّ أَعۡيُنُهُنَّ وَلَا يَحۡزَنَّ وَيَرۡضَيۡنَ بِمَآ ءَاتَيۡتَهُنَّ كُلُّهُنَّۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي قُلُوبِكُمۡۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَلِيمٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Turjee man tashaaa'u minhunna Wa-tu'weee ilaika man tashaaa'u Wa-manib ta-ghaita mimman 'azalta falaa junaaha 'alaik; zaalika adnaaa an taqarra a'yunuhunna Wa-laa yahzanna Wa-yardaina bimaa aataitahunna kulluhunn; wal-laahu ya'lamu maa fee quloo-bikum; Wa-kaanal laahu 'Aleeman haleemaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: You, [O Muhammad], may put aside whom you will of them or take to yourself whom you will. And any that you desire of those [wives] from whom you had [temporarily] separated - there is no blame upon you [in returning her]. That is more suitable that they should be content and not grieve and that they should be satisfied with what you have given them - all of them. And Allah knows what is in your hearts. And ever is Allah Knowing and Forbearing.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It is up to you ˹O Prophet˺ to delay or receive whoever you please of your wives. There is no blame on you if you call back any of those you have set aside. That is more likely that they will be content, not grieved, and satisfied with what you offer them all. Allah ˹fully˺ knows what is in your hearts. And Allah is All-Knowing, Most Forbearing.

ayahs.textArabic: لَّا يَحِلُّ لَكَ ٱلنِّسَآءُ مِنۢ بَعۡدُ وَلَآ أَن تَبَدَّلَ بِهِنَّ مِنۡ أَزۡوَٰجٖ وَلَوۡ أَعۡجَبَكَ حُسۡنُهُنَّ إِلَّا مَا مَلَكَتۡ يَمِينُكَۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ رَّقِيبٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Laa yahillu lakan nisaaa'u mim ba'du Wa-laaa an tabaddala bihinna min azwaajinw Wa-law ajabaka husnuhunna illaa maa malakat yameenukk; Wa-kaanal laahu 'alaa kulli shai'ir Raqeeba
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Not lawful to you, [O Muhammad], are [any additional] women after [this], nor [is it] for you to exchange them for [other] wives, even if their beauty were to please you, except what your right hand possesses. And ever is Allah, over all things, an Observer.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It is not lawful for you ˹O Prophet˺ to marry more women after this, nor can you replace any of your present wives with another, even if her beauty may attract you—except those ˹bondwomen˺ in your possession. And Allah is ever Watchful over all things.

ayahs.textArabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَدۡخُلُواْ بُيُوتَ ٱلنَّبِيِّ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤۡذَنَ لَكُمۡ إِلَىٰ طَعَامٍ غَيۡرَ نَٰظِرِينَ إِنَىٰهُ وَلَٰكِنۡ إِذَا دُعِيتُمۡ فَٱدۡخُلُواْ فَإِذَا طَعِمۡتُمۡ فَٱنتَشِرُواْ وَلَا مُسۡتَـٔۡنِسِينَ لِحَدِيثٍۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكُمۡ كَانَ يُؤۡذِي ٱلنَّبِيَّ فَيَسۡتَحۡيِۦ مِنكُمۡۖ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَسۡتَحۡيِۦ مِنَ ٱلۡحَقِّۚ وَإِذَا سَأَلۡتُمُوهُنَّ مَتَٰعٗا فَسۡـَٔلُوهُنَّ مِن وَرَآءِ حِجَابٖۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ أَطۡهَرُ لِقُلُوبِكُمۡ وَقُلُوبِهِنَّۚ وَمَا كَانَ لَكُمۡ أَن تُؤۡذُواْ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ وَلَآ أَن تَنكِحُوٓاْ أَزۡوَٰجَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦٓ أَبَدًاۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكُمۡ كَانَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ عَظِيمًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yaaa-aiyyuhal lazeena aamanoo laa tadkhuloo bu-yootan Nabiyyi ilaaa aien yu'zana lakum ilaa ta'aamin ghaira naazireena inaahu Wa-laakin izaa du'eetum fadkhuloo fa-izaa ta'imtum fantashiroo Wa-laa mustaaniseena lihadees; inna zaalikum kaana yu'zin Nabiyya fa-yastahyee minkum wallaahu laa yastahyee minal haqq; Wa-izaa sa-altumoohunna mataa'an fas'aloohunna minw waraaa'i hijaab; zaalikum atharu liquloobikum Wa-quloobihinn; Wa-maa kaana lakum an tu'zoo Rasoolal laahi Wa-laaa an tankihooo azwaajahoo mim ba'diheee abadaa; inna zaalikum kaana 'indal laahi 'azeema
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: O you who have believed, do not enter the houses of the Prophet except when you are permitted for a meal, without awaiting its readiness. But when you are invited, then enter; and when you have eaten, disperse without seeking to remain for conversation. Indeed, that [behavior] was troubling the Prophet, and he is shy of [dismissing] you. But Allah is not shy of the truth. And when you ask [his wives] for something, ask them from behind a partition. That is purer for your hearts and their hearts. And it is not [conceivable or lawful] for you to harm the Messenger of Allah or to marry his wives after him, ever. Indeed, that would be in the sight of Allah an enormity.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: O believers! Do not enter the homes of the Prophet without permission ˹and if invited˺ for a meal, do not ˹come too early and˺ linger until the meal is ready. But if you are invited, then enter ˹on time˺. Once you have eaten, then go on your way, and do not stay for casual talk. Such behaviour is truly annoying to the Prophet, yet he is too shy to ask you to leave. But Allah is never shy of the truth. And when you ˹believers˺ ask his wives for something, ask them from behind a barrier. This is purer for your hearts and theirs. And it is not right for you to annoy the Messenger of Allah, nor ever marry his wives after him. This would certainly be a major offence in the sight of Allah.

ayahs.textArabic: إِن تُبۡدُواْ شَيۡـًٔا أَوۡ تُخۡفُوهُ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: In tubdoo shai'an aw tukhfoohu fa-innal laaha kaana bikulli shai'in 'Aleemaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Whether you reveal a thing or conceal it, indeed Allah is ever, of all things, Knowing.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Whether you reveal something or conceal it, surely Allah has ˹perfect˺ knowledge of all things.

ayahs.textArabic: لَّا جُنَاحَ عَلَيۡهِنَّ فِيٓ ءَابَآئِهِنَّ وَلَآ أَبۡنَآئِهِنَّ وَلَآ إِخۡوَٰنِهِنَّ وَلَآ أَبۡنَآءِ إِخۡوَٰنِهِنَّ وَلَآ أَبۡنَآءِ أَخَوَٰتِهِنَّ وَلَا نِسَآئِهِنَّ وَلَا مَا مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُهُنَّۗ وَٱتَّقِينَ ٱللَّهَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ شَهِيدًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Laa junaaha 'alaihinna feee aabaaa'ihinna Wa-laaa abnaaa'ihinna Wa-laaa ikhwaanihinnna Wa-laaa abnaaa'i ikhwaanihinna Wa-laaa abnaaa'i akhawaatihinna Wa-laa nisaaa'i-hinna Wa-laa Maa malakat aimaanuhunn; wattaqeenal laah; innal laaha kaana 'alaa kulli shai'in Shaheedaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: There is no blame upon women concerning their fathers or their sons or their brothers or their brothers' sons or their sisters' sons or their women or those their right hands possess. And fear Allah. Indeed Allah is ever, over all things, Witness.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: There is no blame on the Prophet’s wives ˹if they appear unveiled˺ before their fathers, their sons, their brothers, their brothers’ sons, their sisters’ sons, their fellow ˹Muslim˺ women, and those ˹bondspeople˺ in their possession. And be mindful of Allah ˹O wives of the Prophet!˺ Surely Allah is a Witness over all things.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَمَلَٰٓئِكَتَهُۥ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى ٱلنَّبِيِّۚ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ صَلُّواْ عَلَيۡهِ وَسَلِّمُواْ تَسۡلِيمًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innal laaha Wa-malaaa'i-katahoo yusalloona 'alan Nabiyy; yaaa-aiyyuhal lazeena aamanoo salloo 'alaihi Wa-sallimoo tasleemaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, Allah confers blessing upon the Prophet, and His angels [ask Him to do so]. O you who have believed, ask [Allah to confer] blessing upon him and ask [Allah to grant him] peace.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, Allah showers His blessings upon the Prophet, and His angels pray for him. O believers! Invoke Allah’s blessings upon him, and salute him with worthy greetings of peace.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤۡذُونَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ لَعَنَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٗا مُّهِينٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innal lazeena yu'zoonal laaha Wa-Rasoolahoo la'anahumul laahu fid dunyaa wal-Aakhirati Wa-a'adda lahum 'azaabam muheenaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, those who abuse Allah and His Messenger - Allah has cursed them in this world and the Hereafter and prepared for them a humiliating punishment.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely those who offend Allah and His Messenger are condemned by Allah in this world and the Hereafter. And He has prepared for them a humiliating punishment.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤۡذُونَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ بِغَيۡرِ مَا ٱكۡتَسَبُواْ فَقَدِ ٱحۡتَمَلُواْ بُهۡتَٰنٗا وَإِثۡمٗا مُّبِينٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wallazeena yu'zoonal mu'mineena almu'manaati bighairi mak tasaboo faqadih tamaloo buhtaananw Wa-ismam mubeenaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And those who harm believing men and believing women for [something] other than what they have earned have certainly born upon themselves a slander and manifest sin.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: As for those who abuse believing men and women unjustifiably, they will definitely bear the guilt of slander and blatant sin.

ayahs.textArabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّ قُل لِّأَزۡوَٰجِكَ وَبَنَاتِكَ وَنِسَآءِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ يُدۡنِينَ عَلَيۡهِنَّ مِن جَلَٰبِيبِهِنَّۚ ذَٰلِكَ أَدۡنَىٰٓ أَن يُعۡرَفۡنَ فَلَا يُؤۡذَيۡنَۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورٗا رَّحِيمٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yaaa-aiyyuhan Nabiyyu qul li-azwaajika Wa-banaatika Wa-nisaaa'il mu'mineena yudneena 'alaihinna min jalaabee-bihinn; zaalika adnaaa aien yu'rafna falaa yu'zain; Wa-kaanal laahu Ghafoorar Raheemaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: O Prophet, tell your wives and your daughters and the women of the believers to bring down over themselves [part] of their outer garments. That is more suitable that they will be known and not be abused. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: O Prophet! Ask your wives, daughters, and believing women to draw their cloaks over their bodies. In this way it is more likely that they will be recognized ˹as virtuous˺ and not be harassed. And Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ لَّئِن لَّمۡ يَنتَهِ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٞ وَٱلۡمُرۡجِفُونَ فِي ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ لَنُغۡرِيَنَّكَ بِهِمۡ ثُمَّ لَا يُجَاوِرُونَكَ فِيهَآ إِلَّا قَلِيلٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: La'il lam yantahil munaafiqoona wallazeena fee quloobihim maradunw walmur-jifoona fil madeenati lanughri-yannaka bihim summa laa yujaawiroonaka feehaaa illaa qaleela
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: If the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is disease and those who spread rumors in al-Medina do not cease, We will surely incite you against them; then they will not remain your neighbors therein except for a little.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: If the hypocrites, and those with sickness in their hearts, and rumour-mongers in Medina do not desist, We will certainly incite you ˹O Prophet˺ against them, and then they will not be your neighbours there any longer.

ayahs.textArabic: مَّلۡعُونِينَۖ أَيۡنَمَا ثُقِفُوٓاْ أُخِذُواْ وَقُتِّلُواْ تَقۡتِيلٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Mal'ooneena ainamaa suqifoo ukhizoo Wa-quttiloo taqteelaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Accursed wherever they are found, [being] seized and massacred completely.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹They deserve to be˺ condemned. ˹If they were to persist,˺ they would get themselves seized and killed relentlessly wherever they are found!

ayahs.textArabic: سُنَّةَ ٱللَّهِ فِي ٱلَّذِينَ خَلَوۡاْ مِن قَبۡلُۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ ٱللَّهِ تَبۡدِيلٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Sunnatal laahi fil lazeena khalaw min qablu Wa-lan tajida lisunnatil laahi tabdeelaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [This is] the established way of Allah with those who passed on before; and you will not find in the way of Allah any change.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: That was Allah’s way with those ˹hypocrites˺ who have gone before. And you will find no change in Allah’s way.

ayahs.textArabic: يَسۡـَٔلُكَ ٱلنَّاسُ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِۖ قُلۡ إِنَّمَا عِلۡمُهَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِۚ وَمَا يُدۡرِيكَ لَعَلَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ تَكُونُ قَرِيبًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yas'alukan naasu 'anis Saa'ati qul innamaa 'ilmuhaa 'indal laah; Wa-maa yudreeka la'allas Saa'ata takoonu qareebaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: People ask you concerning the Hour. Say," Knowledge of it is only with Allah. And what may make you perceive? Perhaps the Hour is near."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: People ask you ˹O Prophet˺ about the Hour. Say, “That knowledge is only with Allah. You never know, perhaps the Hour is near.”

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمۡ سَعِيرًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innal laaha la'anal kaafireena Wa-a'adda lahum sa'eeraa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, Allah has cursed the disbelievers and prepared for them a Blaze.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely Allah condemns the disbelievers, and has prepared for them a blazing Fire,

ayahs.textArabic: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدٗاۖ لَّا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيّٗا وَلَا نَصِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Khaalideena feehaaa abadaa, laa yajidoona waliyyanw Wa-laa naseeraa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Abiding therein forever, they will not find a protector or a helper.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: to stay there for ever and ever—never will they find any protector or helper.

ayahs.textArabic: يَوۡمَ تُقَلَّبُ وُجُوهُهُمۡ فِي ٱلنَّارِ يَقُولُونَ يَٰلَيۡتَنَآ أَطَعۡنَا ٱللَّهَ وَأَطَعۡنَا ٱلرَّسُولَا۠
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yawma tuqallabu wujoohuhum fin Naari yaqooloona yaa-laitanaaa ata'nal laaha Wa-ata'nar Rasoolaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The Day their faces will be turned about in the Fire, they will say, "How we wish we had obeyed Allah and obeyed the Messenger."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: On the Day their faces are ˹constantly˺ flipped in the Fire, they will cry, “Oh! If only we had obeyed Allah and obeyed the Messenger!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالُواْ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّآ أَطَعۡنَا سَادَتَنَا وَكُبَرَآءَنَا فَأَضَلُّونَا ٱلسَّبِيلَا۠
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa-qaaloo Rabbanaaa innaaa ata'naa saadatanaa Wa-kubaraaa'anaa fa-adalloonas sabeelaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they will say, "Our Lord, indeed we obeyed our masters and our dignitaries, and they led us astray from the [right] way.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And they will say, “Our Lord! We obeyed our leaders and elite, but they led us astray from the ˹Right˺ Way.

ayahs.textArabic: رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِهِمۡ ضِعۡفَيۡنِ مِنَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ وَٱلۡعَنۡهُمۡ لَعۡنٗا كَبِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Rabbanaaa aatihim di'fai-ni minal 'azaabi wal'anhum la-nan kabeera
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Our Lord, give them double the punishment and curse them with a great curse."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Our Lord! Give them double ˹our˺ punishment, and condemn them tremendously.”

ayahs.textArabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَكُونُواْ كَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاذَوۡاْ مُوسَىٰ فَبَرَّأَهُ ٱللَّهُ مِمَّا قَالُواْۚ وَكَانَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَجِيهٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: yaa-aiyyuhal lazeena aamanoo las takoonoo kalla-zeena aazaw Moosaa fa-barra-ahul laahu mimmmaa qaaloo; Wa-kaana 'indal laahi wajeehaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: O you who have believed, be not like those who abused Moses; then Allah cleared him of what they said. And he, in the sight of Allah, was distinguished.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: O believers! Do not be like those who slandered Moses, but Allah cleared him of what they said. And he was honourable in the sight of Allah.

ayahs.textArabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَقُولُواْ قَوۡلٗا سَدِيدٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yaaa-aiyyuhal lazeena aamanut taqul laaha Wa-qooloo qawlan sadeedaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: O you who have believed, fear Allah and speak words of appropriate justice.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: O believers! Be mindful of Allah, and say what is right.

ayahs.textArabic: يُصۡلِحۡ لَكُمۡ أَعۡمَٰلَكُمۡ وَيَغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡ ذُنُوبَكُمۡۗ وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَقَدۡ فَازَ فَوۡزًا عَظِيمًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yuslih lakum a'maalakum Wa-yaghfir lakum zunoobakum; Wa-mai yuti'il laaha Wa-Rasoolahoo faqad faaza fawzan 'azeemaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He will [then] amend for you your deeds and forgive you your sins. And whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger has certainly attained a great attainment.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He will bless your deeds for you, and forgive your sins. And whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger, has truly achieved a great triumph.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّا عَرَضۡنَا ٱلۡأَمَانَةَ عَلَى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَٱلۡجِبَالِ فَأَبَيۡنَ أَن يَحۡمِلۡنَهَا وَأَشۡفَقۡنَ مِنۡهَا وَحَمَلَهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ ظَلُومٗا جَهُولٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innaa 'aradnal amaanata 'alas samaawaati walardi wal-jibaali fa-abaina aien yahmil-nahaa Wa-ashfaqna minhaa Wa-hamalahal insaanu innahoo kaana zalooman jahoolaa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, we offered the Trust to the heavens and the earth and the mountains, and they declined to bear it and feared it; but man [undertook to] bear it. Indeed, he was unjust and ignorant.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, We offered the trust to the heavens and the earth and the mountains, but they ˹all˺ declined to bear it, being fearful of it. But humanity assumed it, ˹for˺ they are truly wrongful ˹to themselves˺ and ignorant ˹of the consequences˺,

ayahs.textArabic: لِّيُعَذِّبَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ وَٱلۡمُنَٰفِقَٰتِ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكَٰتِ وَيَتُوبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَى ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورٗا رَّحِيمَۢا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Liyu-'azzibal laahul munaafiqeena wal-munaafiqaati walmushrikeena wal-mushrikaati Wa-yatoobal laahu 'alal mu'mineena walmu'minaat; Wa-kaanal laahu Ghafoorar Raheema
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [It was] so that Allah may punish the hypocrite men and hypocrite women and the men and women who associate others with Him and that Allah may accept repentance from the believing men and believing women. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: so that Allah will punish hypocrite men and women and polytheistic men and women, and Allah will turn in mercy to believing men and women. For Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
